extracted.name: Avocado-Shrimp Salad
extracted.description: This avocado-shrimp salad recipe combines cooked salad shrimp, fresh cubed avocados, diced tomatoes, chopped sweet onion, and freshly squeezed lime juice.
ingredient_lines: 1 pinch salt and pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine shrimp, avocados, tomatoes, and onion in a large bowl; season with salt and black pepper. Stir in lime juice. Serve cold.
